caller_evidence.chat_prefixes: src/renderer/src/features/chat/components/composer-status-row.tsx: loopAffordance() selects loop_stop_failed (line 1152) for a running loop and loop_clear_failed (1157) for a settled one; restoreGoal() passes goal_restore_failed (2142) to goalCommand.run(GOAL_COMMAND, text, …). The row's own contract comment (409-418) states the prefix is the control's verb and object and 'the reason after the colon is still the owner's own sentence', so each of the three values must read as the START of one sentence — all three do (« Impossible de rétablir l’objectif : <reason> »).
caller_evidence.watchdog: src/main/update-install.ts: watchdogMessages() (2693-2701) reads the five keys at plan-build time because no process is left to call t() when a notice fires; the values travel to the detached script as ENVIRONMENT DATA (LO_UPDATE_WATCHDOG_MSG_*), never as shell source. splitElapsed() cuts each elapsed sentence at its single {elapsed} token, compose_elapsed() prints prefix + the shell's own elapsed_text() + suffix through a fixed '%s%s%s' format, and notify() passes the finished sentence as an argv to `osascript … display notification (item 1 of argv) with title (item 2 of argv)`. A translated sentence therefore cannot be a shell word, a printf format or a script fragment.
caller_evidence.elapsed_shape: elapsed_text() emits '%d s' below a minute ('15 s', '21 s'), '%d min %d s' otherwise ('2 min 30 s'), and '%d min' at an exact minute ('30 min'). First notice fires at WATCHDOG_APP_WAIT_NOTICE_SECONDS = 15 s and the fallback at WATCHDOG_APP_WAIT_FALLBACK_SECONDS = 160 s, so 0 s / 1 s readings are not reachable in production (rendered only as the narrow-duration probes this audit was asked for).

observations: The chat prefixes join in code as '<prefix>: <reason>' (the row's contract comment: 'the reason after the colon is still the owner's own sentence'). French prose typography would want U+202F before that colon; the colon is code-owned, identical for every locale, and predates this delta, so it is recorded here as an observation and not charged to the catalogue.

'depuis {elapsed}' is the idiomatic French durative ('j’attends depuis 10 minutes') and reads correctly for every reading elapsed_text() can emit. 'depuis 0 s' and 'depuis 1 s' render grammatically but are unreachable (first notice at 15 s, fallback at 160 s).
'Force Quit' -> 'Forcer à quitter' is verified as the macOS French menu item, so the one translatable OS action in the delta is translated; the English token is not leaking into fr.

watchdog_taking_longer compresses the app's own status wording to 'la mise à jour est toujours en cours' where watchdog_still_installing spells 'toujours en cours d’installation'. Both are idiomatic and the compression is inside reported speech ('s’il indique que…'), so it is a style observation, not a finding.

Outside the delta and retained on the prior verdict: ui.notices.chat.drafts_offered_name renders French 'Brouillon' at count 0 because fr CLDR puts 0 in `one`; an offer is never made with zero drafts, so the arm is unreachable. Noted for completeness, not raised as a finding.
summary: Delta at 7b32fd2704 / fr 7757c584: 8 new keys read against the frozen English source and its context sidecar, with the 94 prior keys retained on the 5079fd4cb4 verdict and re-checked mechanically. The three chat failure prefixes name the control's own verb ('rétablir', 'effacer', 'arrêter') with the locale's established nouns (objectif, boucle); the five watchdog notices keep both instructions, the no-action-yet clause, the stay-closed instruction and the 'must not promise the install finished' constraint, translate the one OS action (Forcer à quitter) and keep Local Operator unarticled. Exactly one {elapsed} in each wait key; no argument, plural, ICU or NFC divergence anywhere in the namespace; no hostile bytes. Two minors, both risk-only: the retained deferred-toast wrapping risk and a new width flag on watchdog_app_wait (1.49x, within its own ~170-character budget).

The eight added values say what the English says (chat prefixes name the control's act ahead of the owner's reason; the five watchdog notices keep every instruction, the no-action-yet clause and the no-premature-finish constraint), use the locale's established glossary (objectif, boucle, mise à jour, Local Operator) and vous register, preserve the single {elapsed} token exactly where the caller can split it, and are inert as shell data. Two minors remain, both width risks with no wording change required while the declared budgets hold: FR-NOT-03 carried unchanged from the prior audit, FR-NOT-04 new for the delta's widest string. 102/102 keys read; the 94 unchanged keys are not re-litigated.
